revision.reason: Pre-model correction: replace the unsupported full-suite regression gate with task-scoped trusted acceptance and focused context_metrics regression gates.

task.specification: In src/context_metrics.rs, make canonical evidence entity and range identifiers reject leading or trailing whitespace while preserving identifiers that are valid without boundary whitespace and preserving range ordering.

qualification_binding.hash_derivation: scripts/qualify-context-evidence.py load_corpus canonical SHA-256 at the frozen checkout

named_tests.name: entity_rejects_leading_and_trailing_ascii_whitespace_for_every_entity_kind
named_tests.expectation: For every public non-Range kind, leading or trailing ASCII space, tab, and newline returns Err(ContextMetricInvalidity::InvalidIdentity).

named_tests.name: entity_rejects_leading_and_trailing_unicode_whitespace_for_every_entity_kind
named_tests.expectation: For every public non-Range kind, leading or trailing NBSP, EM SPACE, NARROW NBSP, and IDEOGRAPHIC SPACE returns Err(ContextMetricInvalidity::InvalidIdentity).

named_tests.name: entity_rejects_empty_and_whitespace_only_ids_for_every_entity_kind
named_tests.expectation: For every public non-Range kind, empty and ASCII or Unicode whitespace-only IDs return Err(ContextMetricInvalidity::InvalidIdentity).

named_tests.name: entity_preserves_ordinary_unicode_and_interior_whitespace_byte_exactly
named_tests.expectation: Ordinary, Unicode, and interior-whitespace entity IDs remain accepted and id() returns the original bytes without normalization.

named_tests.name: entity_accepts_zero_width_characters_not_removed_by_rust_trim
named_tests.expectation: Zero-width code points outside Rust trim whitespace remain valid both alone and at ID boundaries, with byte-exact preservation.

named_tests.name: entity_rejects_range_kind_even_with_valid_id
named_tests.expectation: CanonicalEvidenceId::entity rejects CanonicalEvidenceKind::Range with Err(ContextMetricInvalidity::InvalidIdentity) even for an otherwise valid ID.

named_tests.name: relationship_constructor_forwards_boundary_validation
named_tests.expectation: The public relationship helper returns typed InvalidIdentity for empty, whitespace-only, and leading or trailing ASCII and Unicode whitespace IDs.

named_tests.name: relationship_constructor_preserves_valid_ids_byte_exactly
named_tests.expectation: The public relationship helper preserves ordinary, Unicode, interior-whitespace, and non-trimmed zero-width IDs byte-exactly.

named_tests.name: range_rejects_leading_and_trailing_ascii_whitespace
named_tests.expectation: Ordered ranges with leading or trailing ASCII space, tab, or newline IDs return Err(ContextMetricInvalidity::InvalidIdentity).

named_tests.name: range_rejects_leading_and_trailing_unicode_whitespace
named_tests.expectation: Ordered ranges with leading or trailing NBSP, EM SPACE, NARROW NBSP, or IDEOGRAPHIC SPACE IDs return Err(ContextMetricInvalidity::InvalidIdentity).

named_tests.name: range_rejects_empty_and_whitespace_only_ids
named_tests.expectation: Ordered ranges with empty and ASCII or Unicode whitespace-only IDs return Err(ContextMetricInvalidity::InvalidIdentity).

named_tests.name: range_preserves_valid_ids_and_ordered_or_equal_bounds
named_tests.expectation: Ordinary, Unicode, interior-whitespace, and non-trimmed zero-width range IDs remain byte-exact while start less than end and start equal to end bounds remain accepted unchanged.

named_tests.name: reversed_range_reports_invalid_range_before_identity_validation
named_tests.expectation: Every reversed range, including ones with empty or boundary-whitespace IDs, returns the exact Err(ContextMetricInvalidity::InvalidRange { start, end }) before identity validation.
